summary: IHG filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its monthly UK Disclosure and Transparency Rule 5.6.1 Total Voting Rights statement as of 30 September 2026. Issued share capital totals 152,593,096 ordinary shares of 20 340/399 pence, with 5,431,782 held in treasury, leaving 147,161,314 total voting rights. Shares repurchased since the prior 1 September 2026 announcement and slated for cancellation are treated as cancelled. Buybacks run under the 7 May 2026 AGM authority and 17 February 2026 instructions. No special-situation event, no deal terms; the figure serves only as the FCA notification denominator.
